text:
Raj Patel: Heads up - a batch of interviewer reminders used the old scorecard path after the ATS update, causing links to 404. Getting notes from two hiring managers.

Maya Chen: How many reminders affected?

Raj Patel: Roughly 20 sent between 03:10-03:40 UTC.

Priya Singh: Any PII exposure or submissions?

integrations-bot: Template error identified: variable {{candidate_profile}} deprecated, should use {{profile_url}}. Current sent body used /candidates/{{id}}. No submitted scorecards detected.

Sam Rivera: We lost momentum with one candidate panel waiting on completed scorecards, they had to reschedule. Not catastrophic but annoying.

Maya Chen: Can we hotfix the template and resend a short corrected note to interviewers? Also add a note for affected hiring teams.

integrations-bot: Patch available via ATS Admin API. Can change template to reference {{profile_url}} and run a sanity render.

Raj Patel: I'll draft the resend: "Quick update: earlier reminder contained a broken scorecard link. We've fixed the template. If you haven't submitted, please use https://ats.redwood.internal/profiles/{id}/scorecard."

Priya Singh: Add a one-line apology and offer help for new interviewers who find the new UI confusing. Could be training gap post-migration.

Maya Chen: Integrations, apply patch and run smoke test. Ops to add template-variable check to migration checklist.

integrations-bot: Patch applied. Smoke test renders correct link. No further bad reminders in the last 30 minutes.

ats-admin-bot: Incident logged: HR-OPS-2026-91. Assigned to Integrations for follow-up.

Raj Patel: Resend and hiring-team note sent at 03:58 UTC. Will follow up on reschedules.

Maya Chen: Thanks. Follow-ups: add template verification to migration playbook, run a weekly audit of reminder templates, and include short UI walkthrough in onboarding for interviewers.

Priya Singh: I'll own the interviewer walkthrough and include it in next week's ops sync.

Sam Rivera: Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Maya Chen: Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
